records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Sometimes the hardest part is just the first project. If you'd like, send me a rough list of what your team's working on and I'll help set it up myself.

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Orchard Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Glad to have Orchard Dynamics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to the welcome email [email:6d1f19bb]. The customer no-showed the welcome call [calendar:7122995e], and no tickets suggest low engagement. 8 days remain, so self-serve activation is possible but unlikely on this trajectory.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first Orchard Dynamics project set up
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Sorry we missed each other for the welcome call last week — happy to work around whatever your week looks like.

Whenever you're ready, the quickest starting point in Wrenfield is one real project with your actual tasks: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you want a teammate alongside you, one can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can set up that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
